source.author: verg
source.text: Ille repente accepit solitam flammam, notusque medullas intravit calor et labefacta per ossa cucurrit:
source.text_original: Ille repente / accepit solitam flammam, notusque medullas / intravit calor et labefacta per ossa cucurrit: /
source.text_english: At once he caught the familiar flame, and a known warmth entered his marrow and ran through his weakened bones:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quia ergo inpossibile est in sensum hominis non irruere notum medullarum calorem, ille laudatur, ille praedicatur beatus, qui, statim ut coeperit cogitare, interficit cogitatus et elidit eos ad petram; petra autem est Christus.
reuse.text_original: quia ergo inpossibile est in sensum hominis non irruere notum medullarum calorem, ille laudatur, ille praedicatur beatus, qui, statim ut coeperit cogitare, interficit cogitatus et elidit eos ad petram; petra autem est Christus.
reuse.text_english: Therefore, since it is impossible for the known warmth of the marrow not to rush into a man’s mind, that man is praised, that man is proclaimed blessed, who, as soon as he begins to think, kills the thoughts and dashes them against the rock; and the rock is Christ.
